pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium to large polygonal patches with relatively sharp edge gradients. Patches on the upper neck and shoulder are larger and more angular, while patches on the mid-flank become smaller and exhibit more varied vertex angles.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of thin, light-colored pathways separating dark patches. The network features high-density junction nodes, primarily tri-radial, with uniform pixel thickness across the visible flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated mane profile visible along the upper neck and shoulder line, creating a jagged silhouette against the background.
